caption: Demand moves in weeks. Capacity moves in eighteen months. The shaded area is the gap.
One tap, six businesses. The request path, end to end.
A country holds regions; a region holds zones. The country decides whose law reaches the file.
The line between what you hold and what the landlord holds moves with what you rent.
Bigger has a ceiling. More does not, provided the thing can be copied.
Cheap to fill. Metered to empty.
The object read constantly is tiny. The object nobody reads is enormous.
The same twenty round trips. Only the distance changed.
Three fixes for distance, in ascending cost and descending order of how often they are proposed.
Changes go to the one desk that decides. Questions go to copies, a moment behind.
Capacity arrives at minute six. The customers arrived at minute zero.
The permitted absence, and the sliver a credit refunds.
Three measurements of the same morning. Only the third is the one a customer makes.
The wall assumed nothing would get in. Compartments assume something will.
One photograph, priced by stop. Two of the six never stop.
Four ways a line grows. Naming the shape tells you which response it wants.
The same drawing, at planetary scale.
The thing you want to buy sits above the thing that is actually scarce.
